name: Sir Selwyn Selwyn-Clarke Market
subtitle: The main open-air market of Victoria, where locally grown fruit and vegetables are sold.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Large open-air market for local produce

facts.label: Land for a market
facts.value: Land donated for a market in Victoria, referred to as 'Terrain du Bazaar'

parts.text: The main open-air market of Victoria, where locally grown fruit and vegetables are sold. It is known locally as the bazaar.
